title: Corbell presses Jacques Vallée on Lazar at his ranch

tellings.quote: things. I pushed him on it once at my ranch alone.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he once pressed Jacques Vallée, a well-known UFO researcher, about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered flying craft at a secret Nevada site. Corbell says this happened when the two of them were alone at his ranch, though he does not say when.
